glosses: to die, to kick the bucket

examples.text: Wer keine Pferdenatur hatte, den ließen sie "abnibbeln", wie sie das nannten; mit Hilfe einer Spritze.
examples.translation: Those who didn't have the stamina of a horse were made to "kick the bucket", as they called it; by way of an injection.
examples.english: Those who didn't have the stamina of a horse were made to "kick the bucket", as they called it; by way of an injection.

examples.text: „Da kam schnell der Gedanke auf, einen Defibrillator zu installieren“, sagt Staerk. Damit eben auch Besucher und Bewohner in Rott bei einem Herzinfarkt nicht „abnippeln“.
examples.translation: "It didn't take long for the idea to emerge that we could install a defibrillator", Staerk says. So visitors and residents of Rott don't end up "biting the dust" in case of a heart attack.
examples.english: "It didn't take long for the idea to emerge that we could install a defibrillator", Staerk says. So visitors and residents of Rott don't end up "biting the dust" in case of a heart attack.

glosses: комп., жарг. ломаться, выходить из строя, переставать функционировать

examples.text: „Wer Rente will, wird gefoltert. Und zwar solange, bis er keine Rente mehr will, oder bis er abnippelt.“
